clips.title: The story
paras: At Agamand Mills, Blackened Skull trophies mark the fight against the Scourge. Deathguard Dillinger in Brill wants them as proof that the Darkeye Bonecasters are being destroyed.

Darkeye Bonecasters haunt the Agamand Mills. These skeletal spellcasters turn their necromantic malice against the living and the Forsaken, seeking to secure a forward base for the Lich King's armies in northern Tirisfal. Deathguard Dillinger in Brill asks for their ruined skulls as proof that the Scourge's mystical vanguard is being beaten back.
